python3 -I - <<'EOF'
p='src/main.rs'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("use axum::{extract::State, routing::get, Router};","""use axum::{
    extract::{Path, State},
    http::StatusCode,
    routing::get,
    Json, Router,
};
use serde::Serialize;""")
s=s.replace("#[tokio::main]","""#[derive(Serialize, sqlx::FromRow)]
struct User {
    id: i64,
    email: String,
    name: String,
}

// Uses the runtime-checked `query_as` (not `query_as!`) so the build
// does not need a live database.
async fn get_user(
    State(state): State<AppState>,
    Path(id): Path<i64>,
) -> Result<Json<User>, StatusCode> {
    sqlx::query_as::<_, User>("SELECT id, email, name FROM users WHERE id = $1")
        .bind(id)
        .fetch_optional(&state.pool)
        .await
        .map_err(|_| StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR)?
        .map(Json)
        .ok_or(StatusCode::NOT_FOUND)
}

#[tokio::main]""",1)
s=s.replace('.route("/health", get(health))','.route("/health", get(health))\n        .route("/users/{id}", get(get_user))')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
cargo build 2>&1 | tail -15
